time_origin: hypothetical reset after first grading period; no dated attendance observed

actions.name: tutoring_block
actions.effect: accepted delivery reduces learning_gap by 0.05 * response_tendency per session; clip 0..1

actions.name: attendance_family_liaison
actions.effect: accepted contact adds 0.04 * response_tendency to attendance and 0.03 * response_tendency to engagement

actions.name: transport_assessment_referral
actions.eligible: enrolled and travel_over_30min == 1 and programme_available; travel is not proof of poverty
actions.effect: successful assumed referral removes 0.03 attendance penalty for four weeks; not direct cash assistance

action_parameters_provenance: all costs, effects, eligibility cutoffs, uptake, delays and programme availability are scenario assumptions

resources.definition: K=floor(fraction*N_initial); tutor_hours=2*K; liaison_hours=0.5*K; money=4*K; administration_hours=0.1*K weekly; per-step offers<=K; reservations consume these budgets before new offers
resources.funding_horizon_rule: do not initiate a block that finishes after week 36; cancellations release future reservations

fairness.need_strata: low/moderate/high from learning_gap and simulated attendance at window start
fairness.target_definition: unique eligible students offered an appropriate action / fixed eligible cohort at start of window
fairness.access_infeasibility: minimize declared nonnegative coverage slack; never violate hard resources

implementation_status: configuration and reset data generated; sequential environment and policy trials not executed

objective.partial_observation: belief/history policy required when latent states hidden

continuous_transition_assumptions.calibration_required: dynamic usual-support retention is not calibrated by the static annual intercept alone

markov_transition_assumptions.initial_state_rule: engaged if A>=0.9 and e>=0.7; disengaged if A<0.75 or e<0.4; intermittent otherwise
markov_transition_assumptions.intervention_mass_shifts: see experiment_plan.md; cap by available mass and validate simplex after every adjustment
